name: node
title: Board node
description: Anything the agent draws on the board, as one generic element whatever its type (D-015). A numbered node (every card, with the everyNode flag) shows the review buttons its kind offers (NODE_TYPES: Check (✓), Cross (✗), Comment and Later on a question, decision or action; Comment and Later on every other kind) and reflects the person's response. ✓ and ✗ are tools with no meaning of their own (D-045): lit, the mark in its state colour is the whole state, with no word; only a card that asks shows a status word.

files.core: node-core.ts (nodeState, nodeLabel, offers, isPressed, flagLabel, FLAG_KEY; no DOM); node-notes.ts (notesView, conversation, replyEntry: a card's notes and replies, put away or not; no DOM); node-time.ts (noteTime, versionTime, fullTime: a time in the person's clock; no DOM); node-updates.ts (updatesView: a changed card's tab and stepper; no DOM); node-app.ts (appView, APP_CARD_STATES, APPS_OFF: an app card's state view, D-047; no DOM)
files.template: node-template.ts (nodeTemplate: the only place the markup is built)
files.icons: node-icons.ts (KIND_ICON per kind, ACTION_ICON per action, FLAG_ICON, INFO_ICON, svgIcon)
files.behaviour: node-note-tip.ts (bindNoteTip: a cut note's full-text tip, on the shared hover tip packages/ui/src/tip/hover-tip.ts bindHoverTip; browser only); node-popover.ts (bindCardPopover: the card popover, a box beside the card opened from a bottom-edge tab or the footer's ⓘ, on the same hover tip with `opens`; POPOVER_SHOW as it shows, POPOVER_CLOSE to close it; browser only); node-app-apply.ts (applyApp, applyPanelSize, bindAppNameTip: an app card applied in place, its footer's name and the name's tip, card-polish FE_04; browser only); node-history.ts (the history box, card-polish FE_03: the ⓘ, the box and its rows; the page fills it as it shows); paused/paused.ts (pauseControls: a locked board's controls aria-disabled in place, shared with the region pattern; browser only)
files.styles: node.css (scoped by the tag; tokens only); node-popover.css (the bottom-edge tabs, the card popover's box and the proposals in it); tip/tip.css (the shared hover tip's box); node-steps.css (a changed card: the "N updates" tab, the step section and the stepper in the footer); node-parking.css (parking and replies: the tip over "Awaiting", the handover box and an agent's reply under a note); node-notes.css (the note thread's head and its Hide or Show toggle, a note's time chip and its highlight); node-app.css (an app card: its slot, edge to edge inside the border, the state views, the footer's app status and its menu, the appTitle flag's window look: no title, the bar and the name); paused/paused.css (a control paused while its board is locked, shared with the region pattern)

states: notes hidden with a new reply

parts.vb-node-num: tab in a gap on the top border, left: the item number (items only)
parts.vb-node-kind: tab in a gap on the top border, centred: the kind, with grip dots; the drag handle, the one place a card is moved from (3_FE_01)
parts.vb-node-pin: tab on the top border, right: shown when the person moved the node
parts.vb-size: nodeSize flag only (D-030): the size control in the top-right border gap; a glyph (vb-size-trig, the person's pick as "◆ S" in vb-size-shown) that lifts an S / M / L / Auto pill (vb-size-menu, buttons vb-size-opt with data-size-pick) on hover or keyboard focus; data-open forces it open for gallery samples
parts.vb-node-content: title (vb-node-title), body (div.vb-node-body, Markdown through renderMarkdown), tags as chips (vb-node-tags), note block
parts.vb-node-steps: items only (FE_02): the step section in the content, under the tags (role region, aria-live polite, named 'Update 2 of 3, v5'), shown while the stepper is open: the version, when and who (vb-step-head), the change chips (vb-step-chips, each li with data-change added | changed | removed: '+ body', '~ title', '- tags'), what the text gained (vb-step-line: the new title, the added body, or 'Body rewritten'); past the last step 'You're up to date' (vb-step-done), which fades
parts.vb-note-pin: items only (2e_FE_01): the note pin, a numbered button hanging off the top-right corner with the latest note's number; data-note is its seq, data-sent once sent, aria-expanded while its bubble is open; hidden with no notes
parts.vb-node-notes: the "Your note" block: its head (vb-node-notes-head: 'N notes', vb-node-notes-count, over one note too, or '2 replies' with only replies; then one toggle that always sits on the right, vb-node-notes-toggle: Hide, data-notes="hide", named 'Hide notes on item 4'; card-polish FE_02); put away (the person's notes-hide), the head alone shows, its count reading '3 notes · 1 new reply' and the toggle Show (data-notes="show", named 'Show 3 notes · 1 new reply on item 4'), and update() keeps focus on the toggle when it is drawn again; otherwise the card's conversation oldest first, like a chat, a new note at the bottom (review polish ruling 8; NotesView.entries in order, never sorted again): each note (vb-node-note, data-note = its seq, data-at its time, data-sent once sent) with who (vb-node-note-who, 'Your note 2 · Sent'), its time for screen readers (vb-visually-hidden, ' · Today 09:42') and in a chip on its top edge, shown on hover and keyboard focus only (vb-note-time, aria-hidden, the whole date and time as its title; data-hover forces it for gallery samples), over the text (vb-node-note-text, Markdown, cut at three lines: the line clamp plus a three-line height cap, so a list or code block is cut too); each note is a tab stop (tabindex 0; Enter or Space opens it) and holds its full text again as a tip (vb-note-tip, aria-hidden, Markdown); hidden with no notes
parts.vb-node-foot: items only: kind icon (vb-node-kico), divider (vb-node-sep), state word (vb-node-status, cards that ask only, and none for ✓ or ✗, which hides the divider too; "Awaiting" in place of "Saved for later" while the agent still owes the handover, FE_03, with the hover tip vb-status-tip "Awaiting context" over it), quick actions (vb-node-actions), then at the far right the ⓘ (vb-history, cardHistory flag, card-polish FE_03) when the card has a footer
parts.vb-app-status: app cards only (card-polish FE_01): the footer's left-side slot after the kind icon (an app card shows no state word), outside the aria-hidden state span. One control at most, applied by update(): Allow (vb-pop-btn vb-pop-primary, data-app-act="app-allow", named 'Allow app: Calculator. Not allowed yet' or '… Code changed', the reason its title) in needs-approval and changed; 'Allowed ▾' (vb-pop-btn vb-app-allowed, data-app-menu, aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, aria-controls, named 'App allowed: Calculator') once the person allowed this version; nothing otherwise. Its menu (vb-menu-list vb-app-menu, role=menu, the board's menu look, opening upward over the panel) holds one menuitem, Stop app (data-app-act="app-revoke", named 'Stop app: Calculator'). Loading: aria-busy on the control while its act is in flight; error: data-error once refused, until the next press. Hidden at far zoom, keeping its room
parts.vb-app-name: app cards only, with the appTitle flag (card-polish FE_04): the app's name in the footer, between vb-app-status and the quick actions (vb-app-name-text, AppCardView.name, written by update()), one line taking the room left, cut with "…"; its tip (vb-tip vb-app-name-tip, aria-hidden, the same text) spans the bar while data-name-tip-open is on the card: the name cut, and the pointer on it or keyboard focus in the footer, not while the app's menu is open; Esc closes it. Hidden with the flag off
parts.vb-app: app cards only, in place of the Markdown body (ruling 3): the slot, the panel's size (--app-w, --app-h) in every state, edge to edge inside the card's border (it reaches past the content's side padding), data-app-state one of APP_CARD_STATES, aria-busy while checking; it holds the frame (<vb-app-frame>, shown in needs-approval, changed and ready; unloaded by update() in any other state) and the state view (vb-app-state, over the frame otherwise): the app's icon or, invalid or broken, the warning one (vb-app-icon), a line in bold (vb-app-head: 'App calculator not found', 'This app has problems', 'This app stopped', the app's title on a past version), a line under it (vb-app-text), the problems (vb-app-problems, a mono list that scrolls and is a tab stop, labelled Problems) and Check again (missing, invalid) or Restart (vb-pop-btn, data-app-act="retry")
parts.vb-node-reply: items only (FE_03): an agent's reply under the note it answers, in the notes block (data-reply = its seq, data-at its time): who (vb-node-note-who, 'Agent reply · label') and its time as a note's, over the text (vb-node-note-text, Markdown, cut like a note) and its full text as a tip (vb-note-tip); read-only (no data-note) and a tab stop: a click, Enter or Space opens the card's conversation in the note bubble (review polish ruling 6). Replies sit under their note oldest first; a reply naming no note takes its place by time (seq) among the notes (review polish decision 8)
parts.vb-node-stepnav: items only (FE_02): the stepper in the footer, shown in place of the footer's other parts while a step shows (data-stepping): 'Update 2 of 3' (vb-node-stepcount), Back (data-step="back", aria-disabled on the first step) and Next (data-step="next"), the card popover's buttons (vb-pop-btn)
parts.vb-node-btabs: items only (proposals FE_01 ruling 2): the slot of tabs on the bottom border, left, each in a gap cut from the line like the top ones; every tab (vb-node-btab, data-tab its name) is hidden until it applies, so the card never changes size. Today: data-tab="proposal", 'Proposal', or 'Out of date' (data-stale, amber) when every open proposal is; then data-tab="handover" (FE_03), 'Handover', once the agent wrote it; then data-tab="updates" (FE_02), '3 updates', smaller (lower case; field report batch 1), with the freshCards flag outlined in the accent's pink with pink words at rest so it is found on a large board (new-and-updated Design 1; the page's or gallery's world carries data-fresh-cards), off quiet (muted ink on a grey line), its edge amber and its words the ink when hovered or open, which opens the step section in the card (aria-expanded, aria-controls) instead of a box; then data-tab="new" (stage5-follow-ups FE_01), a span not a button (aria-hidden, no pointer: nothing to open), 'NEW' in the toolbar chip's tone (accent on accent-soft), shown on a card the agent added after the person first opened the board (`item.new`) and never beside 'N updates'; the card's name then ends ', new'
parts.vb-card-pop: items only: the card popover's box (div.vb-tip, role dialog, tabindex -1, data-pop its name, the id its tab's aria-controls names), beside the card at its top in the note preview's shape; shown while data-open is on it. The proposal box holds one group per proposal, newest first (vb-prop, data-proposal = its seq, data-stale when out of date): who (vb-prop-head), what (vb-prop-what), from where and when (vb-prop-from), why it is out of date (vb-prop-why), then Reject and Accept (vb-pop-btn with data-proposal and data-answer; Accept aria-disabled and described by the reason when out of date). The handover box (data-pop="handover", tabindex 0 since it scrolls) holds one section per heading (vb-hand: vb-hand-head, vb-hand-text as Markdown): Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation, then Sources (vb-hand-sources, a list)

attributes.data-id: the node id; the page finds a node with closest('vb-node')
attributes.data-kind: one of KINDS; see NODE_TYPES in packages/format/src/node-types.ts. Colour comes from --kind, which render() sets to var(--vb-kind-<kind>)
attributes.data-status: open | acknowledged | dropped | commented | later (set by update; an old context note reads as commented). commented is with the agent: the person's latest note waits for its answer, footer 'Replied' (D-046; agents read with-agent). acknowledged and dropped colour only the lit button: no word, no fade, no strike-through (D-045)
attributes.data-pinned: present when the person moved it (set by update)
attributes.data-selected: present while the person has it selected (3_FE_01; view state the page passes to nodeState, set by update): mockup 05's look, 1.5px in the card's own colour lifted about two-thirds of a step toward the strong ink (--vb-select-lift, 35%) and a little more saturated (--vb-select-chroma, 1.25: OKLCH chroma scaled; review polish round 2 ruling 5), every kind alike, with a soft glow
attributes.data-emphasis: present when the agent marked the node as emphasised (set by render)
attributes.data-size: nodeSize flag only: s | m | l, the tier from sizeTier (packages/layout), which picks the width token; set by update before the page measures
attributes.data-size-picked: nodeSize flag only: present when the person picked the size (set by update)
attributes.aria-label: number, kind, title and, on a card that asks, its status (nodeLabel, set by update: 'Open', 'checked', 'crossed', 'Replied', 'Saved for later'), then ', selected' while selected
attributes.data-noted: present when the item has a note (set by update)
attributes.data-bubble: present while its note bubble is open, so the card draws over its neighbours (set by the page)
attributes.data-pointer-focus: present while the card has focus that a pointer press gave it (set by the page, apps/board/src/board/pointer-focus.ts): no focus ring draws when a key that moves no focus (Z, Esc, Space) makes the browser match :focus-visible; focus the keyboard moves never carries it
attributes.data-open: on a card popover's box (vb-card-pop), while it shows: hover or keyboard focus on its tab previews it, a click or Enter on the tab opens it (set by the card popover, which also sets the tab's aria-expanded); the card is drawn above its neighbours meanwhile
attributes.aria-busy: on a proposal (vb-prop) while its answer is on its way (set by the page)
attributes.data-tip-open: on a note (vb-node-note), while its full-text tip is open beside the card, and the card is drawn above its neighbours: the pointer on the note or the tip, or focus on the note, while the note is cut (set by the note-tip behaviour; notePreview flag, which the page shows as data-note-preview on its world); Esc dismisses it, a click opens the bubble instead
attributes.--card-surface, --card-surface-sunken, -: wireLayers flag only (D-032): fills the page sets on the world (board.css, [data-wire-layers]) as --vb-card-fill of the card, topic and note surface over transparent, so a connector drawn behind a card shows through. node.css reads them with the solid token as fallback (--surface; a note's background), so with the flag off the colours are exactly as before
attributes.data-zoom: on the stage, not the node: 'far' below FAR_K, only with the hideControlsZoomedOut flag (on by default, tracker N13), hides the quick actions and the size control (keeping their space); the keyboard shortcuts still work
attributes.data-awaiting: present while the handover is owed (FE_03, set by update): the footer reads "Awaiting"
attributes.data-status-tip-open: on the card while the tip over "Awaiting" shows (hover over the state; set by the shared hover tip)
attributes.data-stepping: present while the stepper shows a step (FE_02, set by update): the footer shows the stepper only
attributes.--app-w, --app-h: app cards only (D-047): the panel's size in px (panelSize), set through the CSSOM by render() and update(); the card is --app-w plus its border wide, whatever its emphasis, and takes no data-size
attributes.data-app-act: on an app card's buttons: app-allow, app-revoke (the action layer's acts, person only, confirmed by the page) or retry (the page reads list_apps again); the page's delegated listener acts on it
attributes.data-flagged: cardFlag flag only (field report batch 2 ruling 3): present while the person flagged the card (set by update from BoardState.flags); the flag button (vb-flag, data-flag, last in the footer's toolbar after Later, drawn by render with { flag: true }) is then aria-pressed with its cloth filled in --vb-state-flag (the flag's own colour, not a kind's). The person's private mark: never sent to an agent
attributes.data-flash: on a note or reply (vb-node-note, vb-node-reply) for a moment while the page brings it into view (apps/board note-hide.ts `highlight`, card-polish FE_02): a ring in --vb-state-comment that fades as it goes (at once under reduced motion)
attributes.data-name-tip-open: app cards (card-polish FE_04): the footer name's tip shows (set by bindAppNameTip; gallery samples set it to show it)

methods.render(n: ViewNode, opts?: { sizeControl: once per view version: data-*, role, tabindex, --kind, innerHTML = nodeTemplate(n, opts)
methods.update(st: NodeState): on every state change: attributes and text only (data-status, data-pinned, data-selected, aria-label, aria-pressed, status word, note who, and the note text as Markdown when it changed; with st.size, data-size, data-size-picked and the size control's label, letter and pressed choice; with st.proposal, the proposal tab's word and label and, when the proposals changed, the box's contents), with st.handover, the handover tab and, when it changed, its box; with st.awaiting, the footer word, data-awaiting and the tip; with st.updates, the updates tab's word, label and aria-expanded, the step section (rebuilt only when its step changed) and the stepper's count; so focus survives

events: data-act button click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> action layer
data-size-pick button click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the size act (nodeSize flag)

hover or keyboard focus on a cut note opens its tip (notePreview flag); the pointer may cross onto the tip, which is the shared popover size (--vb-pop-text, --vb-pop-w), scrolls past --vb-pop-max-h and draws no actions; Esc dismisses it; a press in the tip opens nothing

a click on the note pin ([data-note]) bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the note bubble on the latest note (to edit, or read-only with its replies once history); a click on a note (.vb-node-note[data-note]) -> the card's conversation, every note and reply oldest first, scrolled to that note (review polish ruling 6); Enter or Space on a note clicks it

hover or keyboard focus on a bottom-edge tab shows its box; a click or Enter opens it and moves focus to its first button that acts; a second click, Esc or a press outside closes it, and focus in it goes back to the tab
a click on a proposal's Reject or Accept (button[data-answer]) bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the act with `proposal` (an aria-disabled Accept does nothing)

hover or focus on a reply shows its full text as a note's tip does (notePreview flag); a click, Enter or Space on a reply (.vb-node-reply[data-reply]) bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the card's conversation beside the reply, scrolled to it, whether or not it names a note (review polish ruling 6)

a click on the notes' Hide or Show toggle (button[data-notes], card-polish FE_02) bubbles to the page's listener (note-hide.ts) -> notes-hide or notes-show, the person's private mark; the card is drawn again from the line that comes back

a click on the updates tab ([data-tab="updates"]) or the stepper's Back and Next ([data-step]) bubbles to the page's listener (update-flow.ts) -> the stepper, and a card seen for each step shown; Esc in an open card folds it
whenToUse: Anything the agent draws that the person should read or respond to.
whenNotToUse: Region headings and lane labels; those belong to the region pattern.
accessibility: Focusable list item with a label naming number, kind, title and, on a card that asks, its status ('checked' or 'crossed' for a lit ✓ or ✗); a selected card's label ends ', selected' (a list item takes no aria-selected), and the page announces the count in a polite live region. Selection is not focus: the focus ring still draws on a selected card. A card the keyboard focused always shows its ring; one a click focused shows none until the keyboard moves focus (data-pointer-focus). Buttons are real buttons with labels and aria-pressed: 'Check item 12 (A)', 'Cross item 12 (X)', 'Comment item 12 (C)', 'Save for later item 12 (L)'; pressing a lit one clears it ('12 cleared'), and a second press of the same button within 400 ms is ignored. Text: the content (title, body, tags, notes, Markdown code blocks) is selectable; the tabs, the size control, the pin and the footer are not. Keyboard: Space adds the focused card to the selection or takes it out; A X C L O respond (C opens the note bubble, editing the note not yet sent if there is one; the note pin is a tab stop labelled 'Note 1 on item 4. Edit it'), Alt+Arrows move, R resets the position, J K move between items. A note is a tab stop: focus shows its full text in the tip (aria-hidden, since the note itself is already read in full), Enter opens it in the note bubble; Esc closes the tip without moving focus. Size control: the glyph is one tab stop labelled 'Card size: S, automatic. Change size' (or 'your pick'); focusing it opens the pill, whose four buttons follow in the tab order with aria-pressed; Esc closes it and returns focus to the card. Proposals: the card's label adds ', 1 proposal' (', out of date'); the bottom tab is a button labelled 'Proposal on item 47' with aria-haspopup dialog, aria-expanded and aria-controls; focus on it shows the box, Enter opens it with focus on Reject, the box's buttons are named 'Reject: cross 47' and 'Accept: cross 47', and an out-of-date Accept stays focusable, aria-disabled, described by its reason. Card shortcuts do not fire inside the box. Changed cards: the agent's reply that cleared the card counts as one update, its step 'Reply · when · who' with the reply's words (D-045); the card's label adds ', 3 unseen updates' (', showing update 2 of 3' while stepping); the tab is a button labelled '3 updates since you last looked. Show them' (Hide them while open) with aria-expanded and aria-controls naming the step section; Enter opens it with focus on Next; the section is a polite live region named for its step, so each step is read; Back is aria-disabled on the first step; Esc folds it and returns focus to the tab, or the card once the tab has gone. The flag (cardFlag flag): a button labelled 'Flag item 4 (Shift+F)' with aria-pressed, last in the card's toolbar; Shift+F on the focused card does the same (F alone is Fit), and the card's label adds ', flagged'. App cards (D-047): the label adds the app's state after the title (', loading', ', not allowed yet', ', code changed, not allowed yet', ', app not found', ', app has problems', ', app stopped', ', not running in a past version'; nothing when ready) and never a status word; Allow (in the footer, its name ending with its reason: 'Allow app: Calculator. Not allowed yet'), 'Allowed ▾' (a menu button, 'App allowed: Calculator', whose menu takes the board's menu keys and holds Stop app), Check again and Restart are named with the app, so a list of buttons tells them apart; the problems list is a tab stop so a keyboard can scroll it; the panel's own keyboard rules are the app-frame pattern's.

flaggedStates.paused: lockBoard (N40 ruling 4; the state shows whatever the flag, since the lock is the ledger's): on a locked board (`NodeState.paused`, from `BoardState.locked`) the review buttons, the size control, the note pin and a proposal's Accept and Reject stay in place and in the tab order, aria-disabled and data-paused (paused/paused.ts, paused/paused.css: the quiet ink, no hover lift or press, the not-allowed pointer; a pressed answer keeps its colour); a press reaches the page, which says why. The flag is never paused. An out-of-date Accept stays aria-disabled once unlocked.
flaggedStates.flagged: cardFlag flag: the flag button at rest and pressed (flagged), and a card flagged before a redraw (the flag names no version, so it stays). Kept out of `states` so the gallery without the flag reads as before.
flaggedStates.history: cardHistory flag (card-polish FE_03): the ⓘ (button.vb-act.vb-history, 24px like the flag, named 'History of card 4', aria-haspopup dialog, aria-expanded, aria-controls) at rest and open, and its box (vb-card-pop, data-pop="history", tabindex 0, named 'Card 4 history'; heading vb-history-head; body vb-history-body): a list newest first (vb-history-list, each li data-seq, its row vb-history-row: time vb-history-time with the whole date as title, words vb-history-words, agent vb-history-agent); a row naming a note or a reply is a button (data-history-note, data-history-reply) in the link colour, else text; empty, vb-history-empty 'Nothing has happened to this card yet'. The page fills it as it shows (POPOVER_SHOW); hidden zoomed far and while stepping.
flaggedStates.group note: groupNoteOnce flag (group-note-once task, maintainer ruling point 103): a note on a group of cards is drawn once, as the group's pin (a .vb-note-pin.vb-group-pin button in the page's .vb-group-notes layer, apps/board group-pins.ts; data-group the group's numbers, data-group-note its latest note's seq, data-sent once history, aria-expanded while its bubble is open, aria-haspopup dialog, labelled as a card's pin: 'Note 1 on items 2, 5. Edit it'), on the right edge of the group's lowest-numbered card under that card's own pin (node-notes.ts `groupPinAt`; a group whose lowest card already holds a group pin takes its next card, `groupAnchors`): at rest, hovered or focused, open, sent or answered, paused. Hovered, focused or open, each card of the group carries data-group-ring (a dashed outline in --vb-accent; 'sent', in --vb-ink-subtle), never a box. The card's pin, 'Your note' block and conversation leave the group's notes and their replies out (`notesView` apart, `CardConditions.groupNotesApart`).
